title: Sereja and Sets
statementMd:
Sereja has $*m*$ non-empty sets of integers $*A*_{1}, *A*_{2}, ..., *A*_{*m*}$. What a lucky coincidence! The given sets are a partition of the set of all integers from 1 to $*n*$. In other words, for any integer $*v*$ $(1 ≤ *v* ≤ *n*)$ there is exactly one set $*A*_{*t*}$ such that ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5f8f42add920aa21c3e1cf400d9cd3afe4bcd510.png). Also Sereja has integer $*d*$.

Sereja decided to choose some sets from the sets he has. Let's suppose that $*i*_{1}, *i*_{2}, ..., *i*_{*k*}$ $(1 ≤ *i*_{1} < *i*_{2} < ... < *i*_{*k*} ≤ *m*)$ are indexes of the chosen sets. Then let's define an array of integers $*b*$, sorted in ascending order, as a union of the chosen sets, that is, ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6753342320bbc0c0904ab927b18c861b76f7b96b.png). We'll represent the element with number $*j*$ in this array (in ascending order) as $*b*_{*j*}$. Sereja considers his choice of sets *correct*, if the following conditions are met:

$*b*_{1} ≤ *d*; *b*_{*i* + 1} - *b*_{*i*} ≤ *d* (1 ≤ *i* < |*b*|); *n* - *d* + 1 ≤ *b*_{|*b*|}.$

Sereja wants to know what is the minimum number of sets $(*k*)$ that he can choose so that his choice will be correct. Help him with that.

## Input

The first line contains integers $*n*$, $*m*$, $*d*$ $(1 ≤ *d* ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}, 1 ≤ *m* ≤ 20)$. The next $*m*$ lines contain sets. The first number in the $*i*$-th line is $*s*_{*i*}$ $(1 ≤ *s*_{*i*} ≤ *n*)$. This number denotes the size of the $*i*$-th set. Then the line contains $*s*_{*i*}$ distinct integers from 1 to $*n*$ — set $*A*_{*i*}$.

It is guaranteed that the sets form partition of all integers from 1 to $*n*$.

## Output

In a single line print the answer to the problem — the minimum value $*k*$ at the right choice.
statementZhMd:
Sereja 有 $*m*$ 个非空整数集合 $*A*_{1}, *A*_{2}, ..., *A*_{*m*}$。真是幸运！给定的这些集合构成了从 1 到 $*n*$ 的所有整数的一个划分。换句话说，对于任意整数 $*v*$ $(1 ≤ *v* ≤ *n*)$，恰好存在一个集合 $*A*_{*t*}$ 使得 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5f8f42add920aa21c3e1cf400d9cd3afe4bcd510.png)。此外，Sereja 还有一个整数 $*d*$。

Sereja 决定从这些集合中选择若干个。设 $*i*_{1}, *i*_{2}, ..., *i*_{*k*}$ $(1 ≤ *i*_{1} < *i*_{2} < ... < *i*_{*k*} ≤ *m*)$ 是所选集合的下标。接下来定义一个整数数组 $*b*$：它是所选集合的并集，并按升序排列，即 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6753342320bbc0c0904ab927b18c861b76f7b96b.png)。我们将该数组中按升序排列的第 $*j*$ 个元素表示为 $*b*_{*j}$。如果满足以下条件，Sereja 就认为他选择的集合是*正确的*：

$*b*_{1} ≤ *d*; *b*_{*i* + 1} - *b*_{*i*} ≤ *d* (1 ≤ *i* < |*b*|); *n* - *d* + 1 ≤ *b*_{|*b*|}$。

Sereja 想知道，为了使选择正确，他最少需要选择多少个集合（$*k*$）。请你帮助他。

## 输入格式

第一行包含整数 $*n*$、$*m*$、$*d*$ $(1 ≤ *d* ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}, 1 ≤ *m* ≤ 20)$。接下来 $*m*$ 行描述这些集合。第 $*i*$ 行的第一个数是 $*s*_{*i*}$ $(1 ≤ *s*_{*i*} ≤ *n*)$，表示第 $*i*$ 个集合的大小。接下来该行包含 $*s*_{*i*}$ 个两两不同的、范围在 1 到 $*n*$ 之间的整数，即集合 $*A*_{*i*}$ 的元素。

保证这些集合构成了从 1 到 $*n*$ 的所有整数的一个划分。

## 输出格式

在一行中输出题目的答案，即选择正确时 $*k*$ 的最小值。
